question: The 16th Annual Status of Education Report (ASER) 2021 (Rural) was released by ________ in November 2021.
solution:
The correct answer is__** Pratham foundation**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **16th Annual Status of Education Report (ASER) 2021 (Rural) was released by the Pratham Foundation on November 17, 2021. **
 
• The **ASER is a citizen-led survey that provides data on the status of school education in India.**
 
• **The report covers the following areas**: 
 
 
• **Enrollmen**t: The rate of children enrolled in school, and the rate of children who drop out
 
• The trend of children taking paid tuition classes
 
• **Smartphones:** Whether households have smartphones, and if so, whether children have access to them
 
• **Learning materials:** Whether children received textbooks and other learning materials from schools
 
• **Learning support**: How families support children at home as schools reopen
 
 
 
• The ASER **has been conducted annually since 2005 in almost all rural districts of India**​

• **Goonj**
 
 
• Goonj** is a non-governmental organisation headquartered in New Delhi, India.**
 
• Goonj **is working to bring equity and dignity between cities and villages using underutilised urban material particularly cloth as a tool for development across the country.**
 
• Goonj undertakes** disaster relief, humanitarian aid and community development in parts of 23 states across India**.
